name: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
description: New and old friends join The Wiggles for their musical adventures in Wiggle Town, learning lessons and solving problems as they go.

videos.title: Miss Polly Had a Dolly
videos.overview: Emma's dolly has taken ill and so The Wiggles call for the doctor. Singing this story makes everyone feel so much better. Add some fun with 'Simon Says' and traveling in the Big Red Car and we're all ready, steady, wiggling.

videos.title: Wake up, Lachy!
videos.overview: Dance and follow the actions with 'Follow the Leader', then point your fingers, do the twist and call out 'Wake Up, Lachy'. Finally, join in with the beautiful singing of 'Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star'.

videos.title: Lachy Shrunk the Wiggles
videos.overview: Lachy's inventions always result in lots of fun and this time he's shrunk Emma and Anthony. Luckily, Lachy has a solution, with even funnier results. Join The Wiggles in the world's catchiest song.

videos.title: The Wiggly Singing Symphony
videos.overview: Simon demonstrates the difference between high and low notes to Dorothy while Emma signs the ABC for the hearing impaired. The Wiggles take to the beach to 'Say the Dance, Do the Dance.

videos.title: Taba Naba
videos.overview: The Wiggles sing 'Taba Naba', a song from the Torres Strait Islands all about having fun at the reef. Emma recites a piggy poem, and we all jump in the Big Red Car to travel through the mountains and the countryside.

videos.title: Wash Your Hands
videos.overview: The Wiggles have all been doing different activities and are about to eat, but what have they forgotten to do? It's time to wash their hands. Emma tells us that she can see clearer now that she wears her glasses.

videos.title: Spring Has Come
videos.overview: The Wiggles sing a song in Japanese about the coming of Spring. Emma wears a kimono while the other Wiggles wear 'happy coats' for the delightful 'Haru Ga Kita'.

videos.title: Simon Goes Quackers!
videos.overview: Lachy's inventions always result in fun. This time he makes a drink that turns Simon into a duck. We meet Mumbles the monster, have fun with Anthony's Alphabet and yodel with 'Simon's Cold Water Blues'.

videos.title: Ooey, Ooey, Allergies!
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword plays the musical memory game and then we all learn that some people have allergies through a song. There's numeracy with Wags the Dog, alphabet fun and a song about being safely 'buckled up' in the car.

videos.title: A Lot of Camelot
videos.overview: The Wiggles are putting on a play and use their director Gregory Griggs. Then it's fun with the alphabet and a dance party with 'Hot Potato', 'The Shimmie Shake' and 'Koala-By'.

videos.title: Tasty Science
videos.overview: Professor Simon teaches Captain Feathersword all about volume with a tasty glass of cranberry juice. Wags learns about numbers by counting bones. Anthony recites a poem about a bee and then has fun with the alphabet.

videos.title: Toot Toot!
videos.overview: The Wiggles dance with Wags the Dog while Emma has a riddle about goats and Simon plays 'Simon Says'. Captain Feathersword recites his pat-a-cake poem and Anthony has fun with the alphabet.

videos.title: Invisible Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy's inventions always result in fun. This time, he becomes invisible, but only for a short time. Anthony has fun with the alphabet while we sing and dance with Dorothy the Dinosaur and do the 'Romp Bomp a Stomp!'.

videos.title: Yummy, Yummy!
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur does some counting with oranges. Anthony and Simon sing about Michael Finnegan and then begin again. Dance to the 'Bunny Hop' and 'Hot Potato' while Lachy will engage you with his singing lesson.

videos.title: Let's Go Driving in the Big Red Car!
videos.overview: We'll see all of our friends as we drive through the countryside in the Big Red Car. Children will listen to the clues and guess the answer to the 'Who Am I?' segment. And Anthony has fun with the alphabet.

videos.title: Excuse Meow!
videos.overview: Poor Lachy the cat is not feeling very well. And so The Wiggles must find a way to make him better; music always helps. Anthony has fun with the alphabet and it's a musical feast when we say the dance and then do the dance.

videos.title: Let's All Shake!
videos.overview: The Wiggles make music with percussion and then sing about their friends in 'Everybody's Here'. Captain Feathersword recites a poem about Gregory Griggs and then we dance along like different animals in 'Come On Let's Jump'.

videos.title: Beautiful Ballet
videos.overview: Emma demonstrates some beautiful ballet for the children to join in. The Wiggles sing a song from the Pacific Islands and Anthony has fun with the alphabet while Lachy counts eggs.

videos.title: Who Am I?
videos.overview: Children will listen to the clues and play 'Who Am I?' Wags the Dog learns some musical science as he sees what will float in water. Meanwhile Anthony has fun with the alphabet.

videos.title: A Hair Disaster!
videos.overview: Lachy's inventions always result in fun, so when he creates something that can change hair styles it becomes a hair disaster. Can Madam Bouffant save the day? Meanwhile Anthony has some alphabet fun.

videos.title: Pirate Poetry
videos.overview: The Wiggles love singing and dancing so much that they can transform a couch into a musical instrument. There's just one problem; Lachy is trying to sleep on that couch. Captain Feathersword joins the fun with a pirate poem.

videos.title: The Mango Walk
videos.overview: Professor Simon gives Emma a fun science lesson using a glass of orange juice while Anthony and Dorothy the Dinosaur learn about the alphabet using an apple, but all that learning makes Anthony hungry.

videos.title: Emma's Missing Bow
videos.overview: Emma can't find her favorite bow. The Wiggles call the famous French detective Dr Simeon to help solve the mystery, and it turns out the answer might just be right under their noses.

videos.title: We Like Fruit
videos.overview: The Wiggles need to keep healthy and strong so that they can sing and dance with all their friends, and the best way to do that is to eat lots of healthy fruit and vegetables.

videos.title: Is That Lachy?
videos.overview: Emma has a brand new alarm clock to give to one of her friends. Have fun putting the clues together and try to guess who Emma's present is for. The rest of The Wiggles are busy learning new dance moves, singing 'I Stamp'.

videos.title: Hula Hoop Symphony
videos.overview: The Wiggles have so much fun playing with their hula hoops that they decide to form a hula hoop symphony. Spinning a hula hoop and singing at the same time makes Lachy pretty sleepy, so they need your help to wake him up.

videos.title: Clean Your Teeth!
videos.overview: Before The Wiggles leave for a big show they remember that they have to take care of their teeth. The Wiggles invite their friend Dennis the Dentist over to learn about brushing and taking care of their teeth.

videos.title: Percussion Party
videos.overview: There is always something fun to do at The Wiggles' house. Emma and Captain Feathersword are making up poems while playing dress-ups and trying on cowboy hats, and The Wiggles recite some of their favorite nursery rhymes.

videos.title: Marty Party
videos.overview: Today is a special day in Wiggle House because it is Anthony's birthday. The Wiggles are throwing a huge party to celebrate Anthony's special day, but they need help to make it the best birthday party ever.

videos.title: Is It Captain Feathersword?
videos.overview: Anthony has a crazy new dance which he wants to try out with one of his wiggly friends. Using Anthony's clues, have fun trying to work out who the mystery friend is.

videos.title: Is That Wags?
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword has cooked a treat for one of his friends, but he wants you to try and guess who. Use the clues and see if you can solve the mystery. Join The Wiggles as they sing a traditional Eskimo song.

videos.title: Harry Hula
videos.overview: The Wiggles love playing with hula hoops and seeing who can keep their hoop spinning the longest, but their friend Captain Feathersword doesn't know how to hula. Emma tries to teach Captain Feathersword how.

videos.title: Musical Memory
videos.overview: There are lots of musical activities to do in The Wiggles' house. Join Captain Feathersword and Professor Simon while they play with musical instruments and learn the different sounds that different instruments make.

videos.title: Doctor Entertainment
videos.overview: Emma, Lachy and Simon are taking turns reading to each other from their favourite storybook, but Lachy's reading is so boring that he soon puts everyone to sleep.

videos.title: Singing With Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy loves to sing, and he wants you to join in with him. From high notes to low notes, Lachy's singing lessons will help you sing better than you've ever sung before.

videos.title: Quack, Quack!
videos.overview: When The Wiggles find some old Broadway canes they decide to perform a Broadway style musical number in their own lounge room. With jazzy singing and tap dancing, it's like a musical trip back in time.

videos.title: Slow Motion Anthony
videos.overview: Disaster in Wiggle House as Anthony is magically reduced to doing everything in slow motion. If he stays in slow motion, he won't be able to keep up with The Wiggles and their friends having fun.

videos.title: Lounge Room Symphony
videos.overview: Do you want to make music but don't have any musical instruments to play with? Don't worry, The Wiggly Lounge Room Symphony will show you how you can use your hands, feet, voice and things around the house as instruments.

videos.title: Wiggly Yoga
videos.overview: The Wiggles are always trying new ways to keep healthy and strong, and today Anthony is trying out the ancient art of yoga. Unfortunately Anthony doesn't have much practice with yoga and becomes stuck in a pretzel shape.

videos.title: A Musical Cake
videos.overview: Master chef Murray the Cook has discovered a way to make cakes even more delicious by adding a secret ingredient - music. Murray the Cook goes to Wiggle House to join The Wiggles in baking the tastiest and most musical cake.

videos.title: The Glass Is Half Full
videos.overview: Professor Simon is back to teach The Wiggles about science and maths using everyday objects in Wiggle House. Today's lesson uses a glass of tasty milk to learn about volume, and whether the glass is full, half-full, or empty.

videos.title: Simon Says
videos.overview: Simon always love to play his favorite game, 'Simon Says'. While playing his favorite game with Lachy and Emma, Simon loses control and begins playing 'Simon Says' at super speed.

videos.title: Sign the ABC!
videos.overview: The Wiggles want everyone to be able to join in and have fun in Wiggle House, for the boys and girls who have trouble hearing or communicating in Australia there is Auslan, a special way of talking with hands and gestures.

videos.title: Joannie Works with One Hammer
videos.overview: You can have lots of fun using your imagination, like with the song 'Joannie Works With One Hammer' where you imagine that your hands, feet and your head are pretend hammers as you jump around and hammer away at the air.

videos.title: Doctor Anglais
videos.overview: During one of his many magical adventures, Anthony seems to have been transported back in time and now dresses and speaks like people did hundreds of years ago.

videos.title: Is That Simon?
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword has a brand new hula hoop to give to one of his friends in Wiggle House, but who is it for? Use the captain's clues to work out who in Wiggle house is getting a hula hoop.

videos.title: Professor Simon's Musical Challenge
videos.overview: The Wiggles are visited by a friend from Saudi Arabia, and learn how to sing 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' in Arabic. And Simon gives Dorothy the Dinosaur a singing lesson.

videos.title: Captain's Experiment
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword is learning about science from Professor Simon, who once again shows how the kitchen can become your very own science lab. Emma is teaching a lesson in ballet, a beautiful type of dancing.

videos.title: Doctor Treble Clef
videos.overview: Simon is one of the most talented singers in the Wiggly world, but his cowbell playing could use some improvement. The Wiggles decide to call the musical genius Doctor Treble Clef to see if he can help Simon.

videos.title: Captain and the Tomatoes
videos.overview: Captain Feather sword and Professor Simon are in The Wiggles' kitchen learning about numerals and addition using some delicious and healthy tomatoes.

videos.title: What's That Sound?
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles - Anthony, Emma, Lachy and Simon - on an exciting new adventure during this new series featuring over 70 songs, including Wiggle classics and new material.

videos.title: A Juicy Story
videos.overview: Professor Simon is back in the kitchen teaching his Wiggly friends about science and maths. His first lesson is with Lachy, showing how you can wiggle and learn even if you're just enjoying a glass of apple juice.

videos.title: Captain's Lost Hornpipe
videos.overview: It's National Hornpipe Day and Captain Feathersword is so excited to teach The Wiggles his famous hornpipe. Sadly, Captain's hornpipe is broken. The Wiggles call Hilary Hornpipe for help.

videos.title: Emma's Ballet
videos.overview: Emma dresses up as a ballerina for a Wiggly guessing game. Will The Wiggles guess what she is dressed up as or is it "tutu" hard? We do some "bow-tiful" ballet with 'Emma's Bow Minuet'.

videos.title: Apples & Bananas
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur has a chat to her friends and asks them all about pets and we get to play with some puppy dogs. We sing and dance along to 'Apples and Bananas', and even join The Wiggles live on stage to sing 'Hot Potato'.

videos.title: Emma's Bike Won't Work
videos.overview: Emma gets ready to ride her bike but it won't work. The Wiggles call Willy Fixit for some help. We say hello to 'Little Sir Echo' then it's time for some animal fun as we learn about a 'Talking Cow'.

videos.title: Dressing Up in Style
videos.overview: Emma teaches some "bow-tiful" ballet in her pointe shoes. We scat along with Lachy as we 'Do the Skeleton Scat!' then it's off to The Wiggles' show to dance along to 'Romp Bomp a Stomp' live in concert. It's "stomptastic".

videos.title: Lachy Can't Rhyme
videos.overview: Lachy is trying to write a rhyming poem with the word 'cat' but is having some trouble. He brings back William Shakespeare to help him. We learn all about the letter 'F' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Simon's Brush with Fame
videos.overview: Simon dresses up as a painter for a wiggly guessing game. We can listen to the clues and help The Wiggles guess what Simon is dressed as. We learn about gloriously, great, guitars in 'Simon's Alphabet', then head to the zoo.

videos.title: Big Red Boat
videos.overview: Put your life jackets on and lets go sailing as we sing along to 'Big Red Boat'. Emma teaches us some Irish dancing then we all Irish dance together to 'I'll Tell Me Ma'. And Simon sings a duet with Zamel the Camel.

videos.title: Anthony Forgets
videos.overview: Anthony is in charge of doing the wiggly grocery shopping but he has become a bit forgetful. The Wiggles call Mary and Michael Memory for some help. We do some "bow-tifiul" ballet with Emma as she sings 'Fa la Ninna'.

videos.title: Do the Hawk
videos.overview: We sing and dance along to 'Do the Hawk' with Lee Hawkins. Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends about painting and we do some arts and crafts together. We learn all about juicy, jiggly, jellyfish in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Simon Can't Stop Yodelling
videos.overview: Simon smells a special yodeling flower and can't stop yodeling. The Wiggles call Dr Heidi Von Trappington for help. The yodeling continues as we sing along to 'Simon's Cold Water Blues'.

videos.title: Cowboy Anthony
videos.overview: Anthony dresses up as a cowboy for a wiggly guessing game. We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Anthony is dressed up as. The western fun continues as we sing along to 'Cowboys and Cowgirls' live in the House.

videos.title: Simon's Sad Fruit Salad
videos.overview: Simon's singing is making him feel too sad to eat his fruit salad. The Wiggles call Jonathon Joy and Cindy Serenity to help Simon feel better. We sing and dance along to 'Shortnin' Bread' and do the actions to 'Simon Says'.

videos.title: The Talking Cow
videos.overview: It's down to the farm to sing and dance along with the 'Talking Cow'. Emma teaches a hip hop dance lesson and Simon teaches us about the letter 'N'.

videos.title: Beaky Can't Sing
videos.overview: Lachy tries to sing an Italian duet with his bird Beaky but Beaky can't sing. The Wiggles call Bertie Birdman for help. We jump along with 'Five Little Joeys' and dance the ballet to 'Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star'.

videos.title: Little Sir Echo
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends all about instruments and we watch a band playing their instruments. We say hello to 'Little Sir Echo' and Simon sings a duet with Zamel the Camel.

videos.title: Ahoy There, Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy is dressing up as a sailor for a wiggly guessing game. We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Lachy is dressed as. We all dress up in style and sing along to 'Dressing Up'.

videos.title: Emma Can't Read
videos.overview: Emma tries to read a book but can't see anything. The Wiggles call Dr Spectacle to help Emma see again. Then we all sing along to 'I've Got My Glasses On'. We can see clearly now.

videos.title: This Little Piggy
videos.overview: Emma teaches us some jazz dancing and we learn how to do a jazz turn. We dance some "bow-tiful" ballet in 'Emma's Bow Minuet' and sing along to 'This Little Piggy Went to Market' with special guest Lee Hawkins.

videos.title: Beep! Beep! Buckle Up!
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends about driving in the car and we learn about car safety as we sing along to 'Beep. Beep. Buckle Up!' Simon sings a duet with Zamel the Camel and we watch the wheels go round and round.

videos.title: Anthony's Singing
videos.overview: Anthony keeps singing too loudly. The Wiggles call volume control specialists Senator Soul and Lady Rock and Roll to help Anthony get his voice back to normal. We sing along and do the actions to 'Michael Finnegan'.

videos.title: King Simon
videos.overview: Simon dresses up as a king for a wiggly guessing game. We use the clues to help The Wiggles guess what Simon is dressed as. We learn all about a vivacious, vibrant violin in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Wiggle Talk
videos.overview: Simon is only speaking in Wiggle words. The Wiggles call Dr Rock for some help. We hear about a wild, wonderful wolf in 'Simon's Alphabet' and sing along to 'Have a Good Day (Kia Pai to Ra)'.

videos.title: Wiggly Picnic
videos.overview: We have a wiggly ballet lesson with Emma and dance the ballet to 'Fa la Ninna'. Dorothy the Dinosaur talks to her friends about going on a wiggly picnic and so then we have a picnic together.

videos.title: Beaky Overeats
videos.overview: The Wiggles have accidentally overfed their bird, Beaky. They call Dr Gallah for some help. We flap our wings and dance along to 'Feeling Chirpy' and then it's time for some alphabet fun with Professor Simon.

videos.title: Zamel the Camel
videos.overview: Get ready to sing along to 'Zamel the Camel' and count the humps on Zamel's back. We'll help The Wiggles wash a puppy dog as they sing 'Scrubby, Dub, Dub', and learn about the letter 'Z' with Professor Simon.

videos.title: Wags Has Lost His Wiggle
videos.overview: Anthony dresses up as a spider as we do the actions to 'Itsy Bitsy Spider'. We discover that Wags has lost his wiggle. The Wiggles call Dr Antonio, Maria and Lucia to help Wags. Will Wags get his Wiggle back?

videos.title: Miss Lucy Had a Ducky
videos.overview: Sing along with The Wiggles as they tell the story of 'Miss Lucy Had a Ducky'. We have a tap dancing lesson with Emma and learn how to do a shuffle. We learn about the letter 'B' with Professor Simon.

videos.title: A Mariachi Moment
videos.overview: Anthony has dressed up as a mariachi musician for a wiggly guessing game. I wonder if the other Wiggles will guess what Anthony is dressed as. We sing a spooky song about Mumbles the Monster and the dancing continues.

videos.title: Riding in the Big Red Car
videos.overview: Let's all buckle up and sing along as we go riding in the Big Red Car. There's more musical fun as we go 'Dancing on the High Seas' with Captain Feathersword then it's off to The Wiggles' show to dance.

videos.title: The Laughing Doctor
videos.overview: Simon has trouble singing the high notes so The Wiggles call Dr High-Low to help Simon out. We sing and dance along to 'The Full Moon Melody' and dance some beautiful ballet to 'Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star'.

videos.title: Irish Dancing!
videos.overview: It's time for a wiggly dance class with Emma. We learn how to do some Irish dancing. Dorothy has a chat to her friends all about safe swimming then it's off to the pools.

videos.title: Emma the Firefighter
videos.overview: Emma is dressing as a firefighter for a wiggly guessing game. Can The Wiggles guess what she is dressed as using the clues? We learn about glorious, great guitars in 'Simon's Alphabet' then it's time for a musical treat.

videos.title: Lachy's Orange Hair!
videos.overview: Lachy's hair turns orange so The Wiggles call Professor Perm for help. Can she return Lachy's hair to it's former glory? We learn about the letter 'H' with Professor Simon then it's time to get jumping as we sing and dance.

videos.title: Romp Bomp a Stomp
videos.overview: Simon sings an operatic duet with Zamel the Camel. Then it's time to relax as we sing 'Koala-By' with some sleeping koalas. We have some literacy fun with Professor Simon then it's time to watch The Wiggles perform.

videos.title: What's Your Favourite Nursery Rhyme?
videos.overview: We dance some beautiful ballet with Emma, Wags and the wiggly ballerinas. Simon asks us "what's your favorite nursery rhyme?" and we do all the actions to 'The Wheels on the Bus'.

videos.title: Detective Lachy
videos.overview: Lachy is dressing up for a wiggly guessing game. I wonder if The Wiggles can guess what he is dressed as by using the clues. We sail along the ocean blue in the 'Big Red Boat' then groove along to 'Hey, Wags.

videos.title: Emma's Bad Hair Day
videos.overview: The wind has blown Emma's hair everywhere. They call Dr Hairy and his sister Harriet to help fix Emma's hair problem. We learn all about the letter 'L' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Lachy Can't Sing
videos.overview: Lachy has lost his voice. The Wiggles call Dr Phillipa Frog for help. Will Lachy get his voice back in time for The Wiggles' town concert? We dance some beautiful ballet with Emma as she sings 'Sur le Pont D' Avignon'.

videos.title: Say the Dance, Do the Dance
videos.overview: Emma teaches us how to do some ballet in a Wiggly dance lesson. It's so "bow-tiful". The dancing continues as we sing and dance along to 'Say the Dance, Do the Dance'. We practice our literacy with Professor Simon.

videos.title: Emma's Missing Bow
videos.overview: Emma has lost her bow. The Wiggles call bow detectives Lucia, Maria and Antonio, as well as Chief Inspector Hawk. Will they be able to find Emma's bow? Professor Simon teaches us about the letter 'O' then we sing and dance.

videos.title: Captain's Magic Buttons
videos.overview: Anthony is all dressed up for a wiggly guessing game. Will The Wiggles guess what Anthony is dressed as by using the clues? Things get spooky as we sing and dance along to 'Skeleton Scat'.

videos.title: Simon the Opera Singer
videos.overview: Simon is dressed up as an opera singer for a wiggly guessing game. I wonder if The Wiggles can guess what Simon is dressed up as. We learn about the letter 'Q' in 'Simon's Alphabet' and groove along to 'Pappadum'.

videos.title: Dorothy's Baking
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur chats to her friends all about their favourite foods then we bake a cake together in the kitchen. We watch the wheels go round and round in 'Jack's Wheelchair Song'.

videos.title: Lachy's Bunny Caller
videos.overview: Lachy has trouble calling a bunny and ends up with Mr Funny and Sunny. Will Lachy be able to find some bunnies? We bounce along to the 'Bunny Hop' and take a drive and sing along to 'In the Big Red Car We Like to Ride'.

videos.title: Food, Trains and Animals!
videos.overview: Dorothy the Dinosaur has a chat to her friends all about healthy food, and then we head to the kitchen to make a sandwich. We learn all about the letter 'T' in 'Simon's Alphabet' and sing 'Wobbly Camel' in The Wiggles' house.

videos.title: Princess Emma of Wiggle House
videos.overview: Emma dresses up as a princess for a wiggly guessing game. Will The Wiggles guess what Emma is dressed up as? We dance along to 'Emma's Bow Minuet', and learn about all the treasures Emma keeps in her room.

videos.title: Anthony Has Overeaten!
videos.overview: Anthony has eaten too much food and isn't feeling too good. The Wiggles call Phil Fitness to help Anthony out. Will Phil be able to help Anthony feel better?

videos.title: Hip Hop with Emma
videos.overview: We have a wiggly dance lesson with Emma and learn how to do some hip hop. We 'Do the Hawk' with special guest Lee Hawkins and do the actions to 'Pufferbillies'. We learn all about the letter 'W' in 'Simon's Alphabet'.

videos.title: Lachy's Bird Poem
videos.overview: Lachy is having trouble finding rhyming words for his poetry. Lachy calls Beaky the Galah to help him out. Will Lachy be able to finish his poem? We move our arms just like a birdy and dance along to 'Feeling Chirpy'.

videos.title: I'll Tell Me Ma!
videos.overview: Anthony dresses up in style for a wiggly guessing game. I wonder if The Wiggles will guess what Anthony is dressed up as. We do some Irish dancing to 'I'll Tell Me Ma' with Emma and the wiggly Irish dancers.

videos.title: Lachy's Pappadum Party
videos.overview: Lachy is having trouble with his most recent invention. Dr Good-Food comes to the rescue to help Lachy out. We do the actions to 'The Wheels on the Bus' and sing and dance along to 'Pappadum'.

videos.title: The Transportation Parade
videos.overview: It's "The Transportation Parade" in Wiggle Town! All The Wiggles and their friends will be driving in the parade for this fun-filled event. Plus, Captain Feathersword has a gift for all his friends.

videos.title: Exercising with Our Friends
videos.overview: It's Exercise Day and Bok and Anthony are visited by a world-famous physical instructor. Then, The Wiggles and friends show each other their favourite exercise moves and do them all together.

videos.title: Teamwork in Wiggle Town
videos.overview: The Wiggles are going on a picnic on the SS Feathersword, but before they set sail, they need to make a flag to go on the mast. Meanwhile, Anthony is minding the food, and this proves to be a problem!

videos.title: I Can See You, You Can See Me
videos.overview: Emma, Samuel and Bok are looking in the mirror to see what they can see and decide to draw self-portraits. Later, The Wiggles are all busy doing their own thing and are joined by their wiggly friends.

videos.title: Wash Your Hands
videos.overview: Lachy has been busy baking scones for The Wiggles and their friends. Anthony is excited to have one, but before he can, he must make sure his hands are clean which proves to be a challenge!

videos.title: Brr It's Cold Outside
videos.overview: It's cold outside and The Wiggles have on their cold weather outfits to keep warm. In the distance they hear teeth chattering so decide to investigate to find out who it could be and if they can help.

videos.title: We're All Fruit Salad
videos.overview: The Wiggles are feeling hungry and so want to make a fruit salad. There's just one problem, they don't have any fruit! It's decided that Anthony will visit their friends to see if they can help.

videos.title: Captain's Birthday Party
videos.overview: It's Captain Feathersword's birthday and he's organised a party to celebrate. The Wiggles and friends are all invited, but panic sets in when the party is due to start and they still haven't arrived.

videos.title: The Instruments We Love to Play
videos.overview: It's Musical Instrument Day in Wiggle Town and each of The Wiggles have a different instrument and decide to play them all together. It’s then time for a wiggly jam session with all their friends.

videos.title: How Are You Feeling Today?
videos.overview: Lachy's been making a vase for the other Wiggles, but accidentally drops it causing it to break. Luckily, when Captain Feathersword sees what happens and that Lachy is upset he comes to the rescue!

videos.title: Emma's Missing Glasses
videos.overview: Emma wants to read the other Wiggles a book, but she can't find her glasses! They all try and help to find them, but eventually discover that Lachy's forgetfulness is part of the problem.

videos.title: Rainbow of Colours
videos.overview: It's been raining and Emma was hoping to see a rainbow but can't find one. It's decided she'll draw one instead, so she calls on her wiggly friends to help her find pencils in all different colours.

videos.title: The Foods We Love to Eat
videos.overview: The Wiggles have been so busy that they have forgotten to eat! They each have a healthy snack and then decide to check on their wiggly friends to see if they might be hungry too.

videos.title: Old McDonald Had a Farm
videos.overview: It's dress up as your favourite animal day in Wiggle Town, what is your favourite animal? While looking for dress ups, Tsehay and John come across a cow hat, who does it belong to?

videos.title: A Sailor Went to Sea
videos.overview: Simon and Caterina are in Wiggly Kitchen looking for snacks for their trip to the beach, while looking they come across a beautiful seashell. There is a mystery in Wiggle Town, who could it belong to?

videos.title: Pufferbillies
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword and Lachy find a train ticket in the Wiggly Kitchen, what do you do with a train ticket? Sing along to 'Pufferbillies'; toot toot, off we go, then the Tree of Wisdom is here to help.

videos.title: This Little Piggy
videos.overview: Join Anthony and Lucia in the Wiggly Kitchen, what will they find today? It's then time for some finger play fun with 'This Little Piggy' then the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town are here to help.

videos.title: The Alphabet Song
videos.overview: Simon and Evie find a pair of glasses in the Wiggly Kitchen and they don't know what to do with them. The Tree of Wisdom is here to help. Sing along and learn the alphabet with the 'ABC Alphabet Song'.

videos.title: I Like to Eat Apples and Bananas
videos.overview: Tsehay and John are in the Wiggly Kitchen doing some meal prep for a post work out meal and they find an apple and banana, what could they make? Sing and dance along to the classic 'Apples and Bananas'.

videos.title: Joannie Works With Five Hammers
videos.overview: Join Anthony and Simon in the Wiggly Kitchen where there are so many great sounds. What will they find in the Wiggly Kitchen today? Get your hammers ready and sing along to 'Joannie Works with Five Hammers'.

videos.title: Incy Wincy Spider
videos.overview: Caterina and John find a beautiful red rose fresh from the garden in the Wiggly Kitchen, who could have brought it inside? Sing along with the classic fingerplay nursery rhyme 'Incy Wincy Spider'.

videos.title: Five Little Ducks
videos.overview: Lachy and Lucia are making animal shapes with kitchen objects in the Wiggly Kitchen and they find a red balloon, but where has it come from? Join in with some fun fingerplay with 'Five Little Ducks'.

videos.title: This Old Man
videos.overview: Evie, Anthony, and Paloma the Mermaid are in the Wiggly Kitchen what will they find today? Sing along to 'This Old Man' then it's time to visit the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town to solve their problem.

videos.title: Rock-a-Bye Your Bear
videos.overview: Tsehay and Henry the Octopus are in the Wiggly Kitchen, there are so many amazing musical sounds and it's great for salsa practice. Tsehay and Henry find a blue teddy bear painting, who could it belong to?

videos.title: Wabash Cannonball
videos.overview: Join Simon and Wags the Dog in the Wiggly Kitchen as they come across a red helmet, who could it belong to? It's then time to join The Wiggles, jump on board and sing along to the 'Wabash Cannonball'.

videos.title: If You're Happy and You Know It
videos.overview: It's a very happy day in Wiggle Town, John and Lachy are in the Wiggly Kitchen and find a flower with yellow petals, what flower could it be? Smile and sing along it's time for 'If Your Happy and You Know It'.

videos.title: Row, Row, Row Your Boat
videos.overview: Caterina and Anthony find a rowboat in the Wiggly Kitchen. The Wiggles sing 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat' and then it's time for the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police to help with the problem of the day.

videos.title: Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star
videos.overview: Simon and Evie are in the Wiggly Kitchen looking for Simon's book and come across some sparkles, who could they belong to? Raise your hands and make twinkling stars, sing along to 'Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star'.

videos.title: Pat-a-Cake
videos.overview: Lucia and Tsehay are singing poems in the Wiggly Kitchen and they find a piano. Clap your hands and pat your knees, it's time for 'Pat-a-Cake' then the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police are here to help.

videos.title: Lachy's Bus Ride
videos.overview: Lachy is in the Wiggly Kitchen and comes across some weights, who could they belong to? All aboard, it's time for 'Wheels on the Bus' then Lachy visits the Tree of Wisdom to help solve his problem.

videos.title: Five Little Wiggles
videos.overview: Anthony and Dorothy the Dinosaur are in the Wiggly Kitchen and someone calls Anthony to tell him the Little Wiggles are jumping on the bed, who could it be? The Dancing Water Police are here to help.

videos.title: Simon Says!
videos.overview: Simon finds Bok in the Wiggly Kitchen; he loves to play 'Simon Says' - join in and play along too. Simon is worried about Bok as he is very quiet, will the 'Wiggle Groove' help Bok get his groove back?

videos.title: Banbury Cross
videos.overview: Evie and Tsehay are in the Wiggly Kitchen playing, 'name that kitchen sound'. They come across some hay and they don't know what to do with it, the Dancing Water Police of Wiggle Town will know what to do.

videos.title: Michael Finnegan
videos.overview: We join Caterina and Lachy in the Wiggly Kitchen, they are on clean up duties after their rock 'n' roll ballet rehearsal. They find some shaving cream and aftershave, who could it belong to?

videos.title: Five Finger Family
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles and sing along with the classic nursery rhyme 'Five Finger Family', then it's off to visit the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police to solve the mystery of the missing ballet shoe.

videos.title: Humpty Dumpty
videos.overview: Lucia and Simon are in the Wiggly Kitchen and come across an egg. Sing along to a nursery rhyme favourite 'Humpty Dumpty'. Now Simon and Lucia have three cracked eggs and they can't waste them, what to do?

videos.title: Hot Potato
videos.overview: Shirley Shawn the Unicorn and Tsehay are in the Wiggly Kitchen, what will they find today? Sing along to the Wiggly favourite 'Hot Potato' then the Wiggle Town Dancing Water Police are here to help.

videos.title: Londonderry Hornpipe
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword and Paloma the Mermaid are in the Wiggly Kitchen waiting for The Wiggles to arrive. Captain has found a letter inviting him to come for a dance, who could the letter be from?

videos.title: Hey Diddle Diddle
videos.overview: Lucia and Lachy are in the Wiggly Kitchen and they find a violin bow, but what do you do with a violin bow? Moo, the cow jumped over the moon, join The Wiggles and sing along to 'Hey Diddle Diddle'.

videos.title: Captain Feathersword Has the Hiccups
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword is having trouble speaking and is making funny noises instead, so Dr. Knickerbocker tries to help the Wiggles understand the captain.

videos.title: Jump Like a Kangaroo
videos.overview: Simon jumps out of bed, and he can't stop jumping; Evie and Lucia do some ballet dancing.

videos.title: Wiggly Sing-Along Day
videos.overview: On Sing-Along Day, the Wiggles joyfully sing their favorite nursery rhymes.

videos.title: Express Yourself
videos.overview: The Wiggles explore their feelings and learn how to express and manage their emotions with the help of Dr. Emotions; shuffle dancing with Tsehay in Hey Tsehay; leaping like a frog in Wiggle and Move.

videos.title: Building with Blocks
videos.overview: Lucia and Caterina are playing with blocks, but their Wiggle house keeps falling over, so structural engineer Connie Struction tries to help.

videos.title: Playtime Fun
videos.overview: John, Evie, Caterina and Captain enjoy playtime, but their dolls are feeling tired and sore.

videos.title: Music with Anthony
videos.overview: Join Anthony on a musical adventure as he rocks and plays his guitar. The Wiggles love music and it's time for a music lesson. Join Caterina, Tsehay, and Simon who are experts at replicating instrument sounds.

videos.title: Recycling Day
videos.overview: The Wiggles enjoy doing crafts, and today,they are cutting out shapes, but there is a problem. Their recycle bins are overflowing with craft waste; would Rob Ish be able to assist?

videos.title: Wiggle Bay
videos.overview: Get ready for an exciting adventure by the sea in 'Wiggle Bay.' Enjoy some dancing fun with Caterina, John, and Tsehay. Then, sing, and count along with 'Five Little Joeys Jumping on the Bed.'

videos.title: Caterina's Shopping List
videos.overview: Caterina needs to go shopping, but her motorcycle won't start. Will Mike, the bike mechanic, be able to assist?

videos.title: Let's Go Riding with Ponso
videos.overview: Lachy and Ponso the Pony get ready for an exciting adventure. Captain and Evie told Ponso to go fast accidentally. Then, it's time for some fruity fun with 'Apples and Bananas' live in concert.

videos.title: Storytime with Lachy and Simon
videos.overview: Lachy and Simon join The Wiggles for story time. They have great stories and enjoy making people laugh, but this time is different. They were not expecting the reactions they had received.

videos.title: Wags Can't Stand Still!
videos.overview: Lachy and Simon join The Wiggles for story time. They have great stories and enjoy making people laugh, but this time is different. They were not expecting the reactions they had received.

videos.title: Lucia's Favourite Doll
videos.overview: The group sings about their favorite dolls and enjoys a special song about Lucia's cherished doll Curly Sue. They explore the joy of friendship and dolls.

videos.title: Pull a Funny Face
videos.overview: Caterina, John, and Captain take turns trying to cheer up Tsehay, who is having a down day. Sing and learn with Tsehay, count with John, and laugh with Simon in 'Pull a Funny Face'.

videos.title: Evie's Favourite Band
videos.overview: The Wiggles share their favorite things; Evie contacts the manager of her favorite band to arrange a special performance by "The Carrot Sticks."

videos.title: Marty the Human Party
videos.overview: It's a frosty morning in Wiggle Town, and John seems to have lost his strength; Tsehay suggests calling Marty the Human Party.

videos.title: Baby Dorothy Won't Sleep
videos.overview: The Wiggles are babysitting baby Dorothy, but she won't fall asleep; they try feeding her and singing, but nothing seems to work; they call Captain Feathersword, the sleeping specialist, to help them out.

videos.title: John's Baby Nephew
videos.overview: John's baby nephew visits The Wiggles and they discover he has a temperature; Dr. Steffi Scope tries to help; sing and count along with "Five Little Monkeys Jumping on the Bed."

videos.title: Captain Feathersword Can't Sing
videos.overview: The Wiggles are a having a singing lesson today, singing a gentle song called "Butterfly, Fly Butterfly," but Captain Feathersword is having trouble singing softly.

videos.title: The Toy and Fairy Parade
videos.overview: It's playtime at Wiggle House. The Wiggles are having fun playing with their beloved toys, singing along to 'The Transportation Parade'.

videos.title: Pirate Dancing
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword and The Wiggles have an exciting pirate dance adventure. After that, the fun continues with the Wiggly World of Dance.

videos.title: The Wiggles Lose Their Wiggle!
videos.overview: Paloma the Mermaid is visiting today but Lucia, Simon, and Lachy have lost their Wiggle.

videos.title: Eight Wiggles Dancing
videos.overview: Join in the wiggly fun and explore The Wiggles' favourite activities, including jumping, running, and skipping. Wave to Bok the Dancing Puppet, while counting along with 'Eight Wiggles Dancing'!

videos.title: John's Fruit Salad
videos.overview: John seeks help from Fruity and Fresca, the strength specialists, as he faces a challenge of losing strength due to missing breakfast. Explore the letter 'R' then sing-along to the 'Banananana' song!

videos.title: Captain's Magic Buttons
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles on a Wiggly adventure, Captain Feathersword's magical pirate buttons create music for his Wiggly friends. However, a problem arises during the pirate music and Captain's buttons freeze!

videos.title: Wags Is Bored
videos.overview: Robert Irwin joins The Wiggles for a special rendition of 'Crocodile Hunter' at Australia Zoo, and amidst the rolly-polly fun, Wags' boredom is solved with the help of Dr. Dooby-Doo (played by Simon).

videos.title: The Return of the Carrot Sticks
videos.overview: Evie joyfully shares her love for The Carrot Sticks and sings her favourite song but faces disappointment as she has a ballet lesson during their concert. Will Ralph Rockstar (played by Simon), have a solution?

videos.title: Lachy's Shrinking Spray
videos.overview: Lachy unveils his amazing shrinking spray! But, oh no, chaos ensues when Captain shrinks Wags and himself accidentally. Lachy calls Dr. Jai and Normus (played by John and Caterina) for help, will they be able to find a solution?

videos.title: Simon's Rosy Arrangement
videos.overview: Simon is crafting a floral arrangement for Dorothy the Dinosaur, but his roses vanish when he steps away to get some water. Caterina calls Fiore Enzo, the detective specialist (played by Lachy) for help!

videos.title: Drawing with Lucia
videos.overview: It's Express Yourself with Art Day! After some 'Hot Potato' fun, Lucia encourages The Wiggles to draw their feelings. Afterwards Lucia shares the idea of displaying their drawings in The Wiggly Art Gallery.

videos.title: Rock 'n' Roll with Anto
videos.overview: Anthony is ready for a rock 'n' roll eisteddfod, but when he plays a song for The Wiggles it puts them to sleep. It's time to call Caterina, the rock 'n' roll ballerina she will be able to help!

videos.title: Dorothy's Un-rosy Tea
videos.overview: Captain, Lucia, and Dorothy host a rosy tea party. After singing 'Captain Put the Kettle On,' they realise Dorothy's tea is missing something. Captain calls Earl and Grey, the tea specialists (played by John and Simon), for a solution!

videos.title: Tsehay's Lost Her Voice
videos.overview: Today Tsehay is playing a princess in The Wiggles Pantomime but loses her voice. We discover Bok has found it and now sounds exactly like Tsehay, will Icky and Sukie, the voice specialists (played by John and Evie) be able to help?

videos.title: Slipping on the Goodship Feathersword
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles on the SS Feathersword for a fun-filled sea adventure where Captain, Lachy, and Simon spill water due to rough seas. It's time to call Billy Bobbin, the mopping specialist (played by Lucia), for a solution!

videos.title: Lachy's Robot Cleaner
videos.overview: Anthony's belongings have made a mess in the Wiggly lounge room. The Wiggles need to get it cleaned up for Wags' upcoming Wiggly dog dance. Will Do-Do, the cleaning robot (played by John), be able to help?

videos.title: The Teddy Bear Picnic
videos.overview: Get ready for a Wiggly adventure as The Wiggles are 'Dressing up In Style,' and you're invited to join in! The Wiggles host a special tea party with their adorable teddy bears, Bowie, Allen, Ollie, and Francesca.

videos.title: Gardening Tips with Lachy
videos.overview: Tsehay faces gardening trouble with her sunflowers and Lachy, the gardening expert, steps in to offer advice. The Wiggles sing the 'Garden Barcarole' outside as Lachy continues sharing his gardening wisdom.

videos.title: The Air Orchestra
videos.overview: The Wiggles are getting ready for Wiggle Town's first air musician band competition! Captain plays the air trumpet, Lachy the air piano, and Caterina, the air flute. What other instruments will they play?

videos.title: The Wiggly Days of the Week
videos.overview: Join Evie and Dorothy for some graceful 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat Ballet.' Then embark on a week-long journey to explore the days of the week, discover the surprises each day brings, making it full of exciting adventures!

videos.title: Doing a Handstand
videos.overview: Get ready for a Wiggly circus! Join in the fun with the 'Doing a Handstand' sing-along, and you can dance too! We're delighted to welcome Atsuko Arai, singing the beautiful song 'Haru Ga Kita.

videos.title: Dorothy and Henry's Pretend Wedding
videos.overview: Tsehay shares a delightful wedding story with Dorothy and Henry, sparking dreams of marriage. Tsehay proposes a pretend wedding and seeks guidance from Little Lord Fauntleroy (played by Paul Paddick).

videos.title: Reading and Relaxation
videos.overview: In Wiggle Town, it's reading and relaxation day, but when Captain Feathersword slips on a messy floor, Evie, Lachy, and Captain call on Tina and Terry, the tidy twins (played by Tsehay and Lucia), for help!

videos.title: Storytime With The Wiggles
videos.overview: Join Anthony and Simon at Wiggle House for Storytime featuring a princess, an evil shuffle dancer, and Gallant Prince Lachy and Ponso! Will Prince Lachy come to the rescue? Watch and you will see!

videos.title: Dorothy At The Doctors
videos.overview: Dorothy is feeling scared about going to the doctors, but Simon and Evie explain that doctors make everything okay. Sing along to 'Say Aah at the Doctors' and learn the importance of visiting the doctor!

videos.title: What's That, Henry?
videos.overview: With your help, Lachy greets Henry cheerfully with 'Hello, Henry!' However, during the song, Henry says something that Lachy struggles to understand. He calls Dr. Callum-Murray, will he be able to help?

videos.title: The Wiggly Circus
videos.overview: Welcome to Wiggly Circus Day! Watch Lachy juggle while singing 'Incy, Wincy Spider.' Then, Caterina, John, and Tsehay show us their hula hoop skills in 'Hula, Hula Baby.' What will our other Wiggly friends do?

videos.title: Dorothy's Loose Tooth
videos.overview: Dorothy isn't her usual perky self; she has a wobbly tooth, and it's causing her to worry. Captain calls Dr. Pearly White, a dentist who specialises in teeth. Will Dr. Pearly White be able to help Dorothy?

videos.title: Rainy Day Music
videos.overview: Today, Lachy, Anthony, Simon, and Lucia play songs all about the rain, exploring different instruments that mimic the sound of rain. Sing along to 'I Hear Thunder' and 'I Love It When It Rains.'

videos.title: Having Fun At The Beach
videos.overview: Groove and move to DJ Dorothy's techno version of 'Fruit Salad' Then, head to the beach with Caterina, Anthony, and John as Frankie and her mum help John find his missing item!

videos.title: Simon's Bird Calls
videos.overview: Tsehay hears a pretty tune, and it's from Simon, practicing his bird calls! Join them as they make animal noises to try and call a bird over and come along with Buddy on a beautiful nature walk.

videos.title: Wiggly Superheroes
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles for this Superhero Adventure! With a bedsheet to make a cape, and a bit of imagination and Sunflower Power to make their superhero powers, they're ready to help out their friends!

videos.title: Doggy Dancing With Wags
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles for animal dances! John wants to learn how to dance like a dog, and Wags the Dog is here to teach him some tail-wagging moves. Let's Ready, Steady, Wiggle and have fun with Wags!

videos.title: The Wiggly Art Exhibition
videos.overview: Lucia and John are hosting a Wiggly Art Exhibition, showcasing their colourful masterpieces. Sing along to the cheerful tune of 'When I'm Painting' and let art inspire you!

videos.title: Simon's Lost His Voice
videos.overview: Get ready for some wibbly wobbly fun with 'Jelly on a Plate' Uh-oh, it looks like something's happened to Simon's voice - it's shrinking! Captain Feathersword is great at vocal warm-ups- can he help?

videos.title: Where is Dorothy?
videos.overview: Caterina is all ready for a fancy tea party, but Dorothy the Dinosaur is nowhere to be seen! Luckily, Detective Lachy is on the case, and ready to follow the clues to solve the mystery of where Dorothy went!

videos.title: Henry Learns Ballet
videos.overview: Lucia shares her love for ballet and teaches Henry the Octopus some beautiful ballet moves! The big moment arrives when Henry performs his ballet recital. Will he master the pirouette and impress The Wiggles?

videos.title: Captain Feathersword's Pirate Training Camp
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword invites John, Tsehay, and Caterina to his Pirate Training Camp! Can they walk the plank and complete the challenge? Get ready to lift dumbbells and sing along to 'Big Strong John'

videos.title: Dorothy's Surprise Party
videos.overview: A techno dance party to remember! The Wiggles are planning a surprise birthday party for Dorothy the Dinosaur, filled with all of her favourite things.

videos.title: Lachy's Time Twister 3000
videos.overview: Join Caterina and Lachy on a time travelling adventure and see dances from the past! From the 80s, to the 20s, all the way even to the Elizabethan Era, just how far back in time can they go?

videos.title: Colours, Colours Everywhere
videos.overview: Talk about your favourite colours with The Wiggles, and then, oh no! Anthony and Lucia have accidentally turned everyone's skivvies blue in the wash! Luckily, Lachy is here to help

videos.title: Dance with the Tree of Wisdom
videos.overview: Let's dance with The Tree of Wisdom, shake our arms, Wiggle like no one's watching, and learn some new moves along the way!

videos.title: Writing a Poem with Evie
videos.overview: Join Evie Wiggle as she writes a poem! With each Wiggle asking for her help to remember something, Evie makes a helpful poem, showing that inspiration can come from anywhere!

videos.title: Painting Shapes with Lucia
videos.overview: Lucia is painting beautiful pictures of shapes, with Simon's help. There are shapes everywhere in the world to see, from in a sandwich that's cut into triangles, or a square pizza box!

videos.title: Captain the Copy Robot
videos.overview: Sing and dance to 'Captain's Magic Buttons' Captain Feathersword's pirate vest has magical buttons! When pressed, he becomes a copy robot, copying Lachy, Anthony, and Caterina- join the fun!

videos.title: Wake Up Lachy!
videos.overview: Sing along to 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' but look! Lachy has fallen asleep. The Wiggles try to wake him up, and they need your help! Next, come and see what Buddy is getting up to at the beach.

videos.title: Lucia the Drumming Superstar
videos.overview: Lucia is on a quest to find her special drumming suit, the one that makes her feel like a superstar, but it's nowhere to be found- not even in the Wiggly Kitchen! Can The Wiggles help her find it?

videos.title: The Tree of Wisdom's Grand Dance Contest
videos.overview: The Tree of Wisdom invites The Wiggles to participate in the Grand Dance Contest! Get ready to dance, laugh, and cheer - the stage is set, and the contest is about to begin!

videos.title: Music Day at Wiggle House
videos.overview: It's Lachy and Tsehay's turn to decide what music to play in the Wiggle House today! But while Lachy likes a soothing lullaby, Tsehay likes the energy of techno! It's up to Simon to help them decide.

videos.title: Babysitting Caterina's Twins
videos.overview: Caterina leaves twins Dolly and Gigi with her Wiggly friends while she picks up her red Machina. With Lachy, Lucia, and Simon stepping in to help, and Anthony and John adding chaos, what fun will unfold?

videos.title: Wiggle Your Ears with Wags
videos.overview: Caterina needs some help remembering the days of the week! Sing along to help her remember, and then the learning fun continues with a dance music remix of 'ABC'.

videos.title: Making a Sound Song
videos.overview: You can find fun, musical sounds anywhere! Evie and Lucia are making sounds on a comb and an empty stapler, and they decide to hear what sounds the rest of The Wiggles have found to create a song.

videos.title: Simon's Rhymin'
videos.overview: Get ready to sing along with Simon. He's creating a brand-new rhyming song and, with help from his Wiggly friends, finds the perfect words to make a mighty tune!

videos.title: Wiggly Camping Trip
videos.overview: Lachy and Anthony, together with Lucia and Wags the Dog, are going on a camping trip! Join them for this outdoor adventure complete with a tent, fishing, camping songs, and even a spooky story?

videos.title: Sharing Lemonade with The Wiggles
videos.overview: Tsehay has made some lemonade to share with her friends! There is some for Simon, but then there is no lemonade left for Anthony. What to do? Dorothy flies off in the Big Red Plane for help.

videos.title: The Crocodile Way
videos.overview: Lucia plays hide and seek, The Wiggles sing 'The Crocodile Way' to real crocodiles, Caterina and Anthony find "C" words, and finish with a live performance of 'Who's in the Wiggle House'!

videos.title: The Planets in the Solar System
videos.overview: Evie learns about space with Anthony followed by a fun song about the planets. Then, Simon shares tasty treats in 'Food Reviews with Shirley Shawn the Unicorn', and the Tree of Wisdom leads a Wiggly dance.

videos.title: John the Hairdresser
videos.overview: Meet playful meerkats, enjoy a graceful ballet show with Lucia, Evie, and Dorothy the Dinosaur, and watch John test his hairdressing skills with help from the Tree of Wisdom.

videos.title: Learning Shapes With Caterina
videos.overview: Join in the fun with Lucia, Tsehay, John, Lachy and Simon as they sing and dance about Caterina's favourite shapes! From circles and squares to triangles, learning is fun with catchy tunes and colourful visuals.

videos.title: Bubbles!
videos.overview: Caterina and Tsehay blow bubbles with Bubbles the Mermaid and turn Wiggle Town into Bubble Town with a bubbly song! Anthony learns the congas from Sir Leslie Longley and plays 'Fruit Salad' with help from the Tree of Wisdom.

videos.title: The Name Game
videos.overview: Dance to "Hula, Hula Baby" on the beach, play the name game, enjoy a ballet performance with puppets, giggle with Lachy and Anthony and finish with a live rendition of "Watching the Ponies!"

videos.title: Lachy's Friend
videos.overview: The Wiggles must solve the puzzle of Lachy's mysterious new friend.

videos.title: Captain Feathersword's Picnic
videos.overview: Sing along to 'Lucia the Koala', join Captain Feathersword's picnic with Wags, and laugh with Lachy and Tsehay's jokes!

videos.title: Folding Towels Can Be Fun!
videos.overview: Tsehay has fruit in her hat and Lucia has ribbons in her plaits as the Wiggles sing the catchy 'Fruitie In My Hat'! Meanwhile, Lachy helps Simon turn folding laundry into a fun activity.

videos.title: Dorothy's Dancing Roses
videos.overview: Start the day in the sunshine with 'The Garden Dance (The Ants Are Marching)'. Tsehay shares her rap with Lucia, then Simon, Lachy, and Anthony sing with dancing roses for Dorothy.

videos.title: I Spy: Letters and Sounds
videos.overview: Jump in with 'Kangaroo Jumping'! Evie teaches Eye Spy, Buddy leads the 'Italian Word Song - A A's', and the Wiggles sing 'The Spring Song'.

videos.title: John and Henry's Sea Creature Adventure
videos.overview: Join the Wiggles and the Tree of Wisdom for the 'Friendly Greeting Song'! John dives into an underwater adventure with Henry the Octopus to meet sea creatures up close.

videos.title: Crossword Puzzle
videos.overview: Join the fun with a Wiggly Conga line, a crossword challenge with the Tree of Wisdom and Captain Feathersword, the 'Italian Word Song - O O's', a round of Guess That Animal, and finish with a live 'Bin Night' performance!

videos.title: Walk a Million Miles
videos.overview: Join Dorothy the Dinosaur and The Wiggles singing her praise in Wiggle Town! Simon and Tsehay get into a walking competition and Simon sets out to 'Walk a Million Miles'.

videos.title: Dancing the Hornpipe on the S.S Feathersword
videos.overview: Put on your party hats! Lucia and Tsehay teach Captain Feathersword the hornpipe, John explores positive 'P' words, and Tsehay joins a Dorothy DJ Party with Henry the Octopus.

videos.title: The Tree of Wisdom's Hat
videos.overview: Come along to Dorothy's party! Lachy practices sun safety with the Tree of Wisdom and sings 'If I Had a Hat'. Caterina joins Dorothy's Dance Party for a remix of 'Row, Row, Row Your Boat'.

videos.title: Tap Dancing with Lucia
videos.overview: The Tree of Wisdom teaches The Wiggles exciting new dance moves! Lucia shows off her tap-dancing skills, leading to a fun song all about her talents.

videos.title: Simon Has the Hiccups
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles for a day of fun! The Tree of Wisdom shakes its leafy branches, Simon battles hiccups with help from his friends, and everyone heads to the beach for 'Coco Loco'.

videos.title: Making a Happy Story
videos.overview: Pop into the fun with 'Hot Poppin' Popcorn' and a Tree of Wisdom tune! The Wiggles create a happiness storybook, Lucia joins a Dorothy Dance Party for 'Quack Quack', and the day ends with a lively preschool performance.

videos.title: Evie's Insect Adventure
videos.overview: It's time to march to some great music! Evie is in the garden looking for insects - with her special tool, a magnifying glass, and she finds lots of Wiggly insects!

videos.title: Limbo!
videos.overview: Get ready to Wiggle! The Tree of Wisdom joins Evie, Tsehay and John to share their favourite dance moves. Then, Caterina and Lachy help teach the limbo - even Captain Feathersword joins in!

videos.title: Playing Fetch with Wags and Captain Feathersword
videos.overview: The Wiggles sing along as their pickup truck rolls on by! Captain Feathersword teaches Wags to fetch with hilarious results, then enjoy a live performance of "Move Your Arms Like Henry." Songs

videos.title: The Mayor of Wiggle Town
videos.overview: It's election day in Wiggle Town! The Wiggles need to vote for the new mayor of Wiggle Town - who will make Wiggle Town Mayor?

videos.title: Trimming the Hedges
videos.overview: "Sham Sham Poo Poo", shampoo your hair! Lachy turns everyday life into a musical, Rhymin' Simon gets rhyming and the Wiggles enjoy a colourful garden party.

videos.title: Bush Doof!
videos.overview: Join The Wiggles for more Wiggly fun! Sing along with "Anthony Ant", then watch John host the hilarious game show, Guess That Animal, with Lachy as a contestant.

videos.title: The Captain of the Opera
videos.overview: Come on down to Wiggle Town! A sparkly adventure full of music, magic and fun! Join Simon, the Opera Captain, Lucia and Tsehay for a musical journey and a live performance of "Teddy Bear Family."

videos.title: Easel-y Done!
videos.overview: Dance along to the Limbo, explore feelings with Anthony and sing a shapes song. Enjoy Food Reviews With Simon and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn, and a preschool performance of Round the Garden

videos.title: The Great Cowbell and Kazoo Duet!
videos.overview: Evie shares some of her fave Wiggly books, Lucia plays hide and seek and makes a pasta tambourine, Buddy explores a truck expo, plus Lachy and Simon perform a musical duet on cowbell and kazoo.

videos.title: Evie Goes to the Beach
videos.overview: A tea party at the park kicks off the fun. Caterina, John and Tsehay create a story starring Evie, then bounce along to Kangaroo Jumping before Simon and Shirley Shawn the Unicorn chat about food.

videos.title: Doing the Dishes Is Fun!
videos.overview: Simon and Lachy find a way to do the dishes by singing and dancing, while Anthony learns to play the violin and performs Fruit Salad Yummy Yummy and Guess That Animal adds some puppet fun.

videos.title: Surf's Up!
videos.overview: At the beach, Buddy shows Tsehay, John and Evie how exciting surfing can be. Everyone then sings and dances along to Bush Doof, before Lucia gets creative and makes a colourful pasta necklace.

videos.title: The Wiggles Go to the Library
videos.overview: The fun begins with Coco Loco by the beach. Evie shares her fave library books that she's just borrowed to celebrate reading, Guess That Animal returns and the Wiggles sing Five Fingered Family.

videos.title: Anthony Learns the Theremin!
videos.overview: The Tree of Wisdom and The Wiggles celebrate nature with a song, Lachy joins Captain Feathersword for Giggle with a Wiggle, Tsehay teaches the Hokey Pokey, and Anthony learns the theremin.

videos.title: Hot Poppin' Popcorn!
videos.overview: Get moving with 'Get Ready to Wiggle', sing along to 'Hot Poppin' Popcorn!', enjoy ballet with Evie, Lucia and their puppet friends, and dance along with 'Do the Hokey Pokey'.

videos.title: Exercise with The Tree of Wisdom
videos.overview: Sing along to 'Dandelion Days in the Sun', enjoy Rhymin' Simon's musical rhymes, and get active with Strong John and The Tree of Wisdom's new exercise routine, which encourages healthy habits.

videos.title: Rockin' Robot Marty
videos.overview: Get your boots on and ride into Wiggle Town to 'Wiggle Up, Giddy Up'. Anthony introduces his friend Marty the rockin' robot, Lachy and Simon share jokes, and everyone sings and dances to 'Baby Shark'.

videos.title: Captain Feathersword's Lost Hat
videos.overview: Captain Feathersword needs help finding his missing pirate hat, The Wiggles give their hula hoops a spin and sing 'Hula, Hula Baby' at the beach, and Lucia makes some simple clay sculptures.

videos.title: Opposites!
videos.overview: The Wiggles set sail aboard the S.S Feathersword for 'Dance the Hornpipe', play a fun game of opposites, and try on hats. 'Shake Your Hips with Wags the Dog' has everyone dancing and wagging along.

videos.title: The Wiggly Garage Sale
videos.overview: Get ready to play along with Simon in "Simon Says", sing and learn about the planets, and help Anthony and Evie tidy up the Wiggle House before they hold a Wiggly garage sale with a fun surprise.

videos.title: Messy Clean
videos.overview: Lachy and Simon turn cleaning up into a musical adventure. Rap along with Tsehay, giggle along with Lachy and the Tree of Wisdom, and sing along to a daycare performance of "Wheels on the Bus."

videos.title: Wiggly Picnic
videos.overview: The Wiggles soak up the sunshine and sing 'The Ants Are Marching'. The beautiful day inspires Simon to plan a picnic, and everyone brings delicious treats, while Lucia creatures colourful collages.

videos.title: Dance, Dance, Dance!
videos.overview: Evie shares ballet moves before everyone dances their way to Wiggle Town. Captain Feathersword and The Tree of Wisdom explore movements starting with the letter 'D', and Anthony learns the didgeridoo.

videos.title: Dorothy the Dinosaur's Party
videos.overview: Lachy and Ponso head out for a pony ride before everyone joins Dorothy's Dance Party. Listening to sounds and clues, Lucia plays Guess That Animal, and the Happy Little Toddlers keep the fun going.

videos.title: I Spy: Colours
videos.overview: Sing and play around with sparkly 'Bubbles', learn I Spy around the Wiggle House to spot colourful items, and join in with 'Anthony Ant'. Then Buddy visits the aquarium for an underwater adventure.

videos.title: Captain Feathersword's Pirate Obedience School
videos.overview: Dance along with 'Dorothy (Would You Like to Dance)?' and watch Wags the Dog learn new tricks. Explore circles, enjoy Anthony's mandolin version of 'Fruit Salad', and sing along to 'Jingle Bells'.

videos.title: Lachy's Famous Stir Fry
videos.overview: Shake along to 'Shake Like a Tree', join Lachy as he cooks his famous veggie stir fry after a shopping trip to Buddy's store for ingredients, and sing along to 'Quack Quack'.

videos.title: Wiggly News
videos.overview: The Tree of Wisdom and Captain Feathersword act out stories from the Wiggly Newspaper in a guessing game. The Happy Little Toddlers make music, Tsehay shares a rap, and everyone hops to it for a song.

videos.title: The Amusement Park
videos.overview: Tsehay shows off her colourful salsa dance costumes, Lucia sings with cute meerkats, and Buddy explores an amusement park. The Wiggles get marching, there's word fun, and everyone joins a conga line.

videos.title: Peek-a-Boo!
videos.overview: Sing and play along to 'Peek-a-Boo', hear Tsehay's special rap for Simon, dance with Dorothy the Dinosaur, and watch The Wiggles explore feelings by sharing their drawings.

videos.title: Playing Catch with Wags & Captain
videos.overview: Sing and move along to 'The Crocodile Way', play Guess That Animal with Baby John and The Tree of Wisdom, enjoy bubble fun, and join Captain Feathersword as he tries to play catch with Wags the Dog.

videos.title: Simon's Pickup Truck
videos.overview: Shake along to 'Shakin' Like a Leafy Tree' with The Wiggles and The Tree of Wisdom, sing along to 'Pick Up Truck', and explore shapes with the musical fun of 'A Square Has Four Sides'.

videos.title: The Wiggly Medley
videos.overview: Dance along to 'The Gumtree Groove', get creative as Lucia spends time drawing, rehearse with The Wiggles and Buddy, and enjoy 'The Hokey Pokey'.
